name: termux_install_deb
desc: 从本地归档安装Termux deb包
cmd: sh /data/adb/lemon_kernel/lemon/dedup/run.sh termux_install_deb export PREFIX=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr; export PATH=$PREFIX/bin:/system/bin; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PREFIX/lib; D=$LEMON_DATA/小柠檬仓库中心/Termux资源库/02-安装包/debs-20260919; if [ ! -d $D ]; then echo NO_ARCHIVE; exit 1; fi; f=$(ls $D | grep -i $name | head -n 1); if [ -z "$f" ]; then echo NOT_FOUND; ls $D; exit 1; fi; echo installing $f; W=/data/local/tmp/debinst; rm -rf $W; mkdir -p $W; dpkg-deb -x $D/$f $W && cp -a $W/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/. $PREFIX/ && chown -R 10431:10431 $PREFIX/bin $PREFIX/lib $PREFIX/include $PREFIX/share $PREFIX/etc 2>/dev/null; echo INSTALL_DONE $f
